citations.narrative:
The licensee transported two Squirrel monkeys across state lines on April 12, 2026 without obtaining a health certificate
executed and issued by a licensed veterinarian prior to transport. Health certificates help ensure that such animal is
healthy, fit for travel and appear free of any infectious disease or other physical abnormality that could endanger the
animal, public health, or other animals. The health certificate shall state that the licensed veterinarian inspected the
nonhuman primates on a specified date which shall not be more than 10 days prior to the delivery of the nonhuman
primate for transportation. All non-human primates that are transported in commerce must be accompanied by a health
certificate. A licensed veterinarian must examine the animals and complete a health certificate.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
